title: Typography / destination and fare pair
slide_intent: Let type change roles between atmosphere and information so the viewer can distinguish a place from a price.
strategic_value: A repeated Berlin field and a prominent fare can extend DB typography across expressive and transactional messages.
demonstration: A Berlin tower graphic overlays repeated pale BERLIN lettering; a BahnCard offer places a large 9.99-euro price beside a card.
practical_value: Compare decorative word repetition with a price-led offer hierarchy.

content_islands.name: Destination graphic
content_islands.spec: Place the colored tower over repeated pale city lettering at left.

content_islands.name: Offer
content_islands.spec: Set the fare prominently beside the angled BahnCard at right.

reference_purposes.Expression: The pair contrasts repeating city typography with heavy fare numerals.
reference_purposes.Application: A destination treatment and BahnCard offer demonstrate two communication uses.
